data.name: Bachelor Sail
data.headline: All Inclusive Packages • 3 Hours • Staring at $550
data.description:
#Wildly Fun and Unforgettable!

We've thrown epic bachelor parties for countless guests, and we're here to make your life easy. Everything you need for a killer party is ready to roll when you arrive. Let the good times sail!

##Duration
3 Hours • Opt for Either Daytime or Sunset Departure

meeting_point.address: 2720 Shelter Island Drive, San Diego CA 92106

data.what_is_included: A 3-hour bachelor private sail includes complimentary drinks & snacks (beers, hard seltzers, sodas, water, etc.) and a light snack bar for you to enjoy during your sail.
data.cancellation_notes:
**Cancellation Policy**
We understand things happen and plans change, that's why we have the most flexible cancellation policy in the industry. Reservations are 100% refundable if canceled outside of 72 hours of the date of the departure. 

**Weather Policy**
Sail San Diego does not operate in unsafe weather conditions, but a light rain shower is not a deterrent. The Captain will assess the weather and should the Captain determine that the conditions are unsafe to run the charter, the charter may be rescheduled or it will be canceled.

- If a trip is canceled by Sail San Diego for any reason, you will have the option of receiving store credit for a future trip or receiving a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
**Please Note:** If you booked a Bareboat Charter for 7-12 Guests. There is still a $150 Captain Fee due directly after the trip. The fee is paid directly to the captain by you. Most of our guests, for awesome service, will tip their captain 15%-20% of the total spend (not just the captain's fee). You can pay the captain's fee and tip with Cash, Credit Card, or Venmo*

[View our Current Captain Roster](https://sailsandiego.com/about-us/)

---	
**We genuinely care about your overall experience from start to finish so please continue reading about all the information enclosed below:**

**BEFORE ARRIVAL:**
Please have every guest sign our touchless sailing waiver prior to your arrival. The waivers are all digital so no need to print anything out. Don't stress if you're having too much difficulty with them, we can always have you sign them when checking in at our office location.

**CHECK-IN:**
Please check in at our office 20-30 minutes before the departure time. A physical boarding pass will be required to board your assigned sailboat. Your boarding pass will be provided at our Sail San Diego office, located at 2720 Shelter Island Drive, San Diego, California 92106.

You will find us on the corner of the first floor across the street from the Brigantine Restaurant and next to Paragon Deli.

After receiving your boarding pass, you will be directed to our private marina for boarding. Gates will open 10 minutes prior to the departure time.

**PARKING:**
San Diego hosts 32 million visitors annually, making parking especially limited during summer. We recommend arriving at least 30 minutes early to find parking or using Lyft.

If using Uber, please ensure you enter our address directly. Do not enter "Sail San Diego," as this will direct the driver to our old location from eight years ago, which is about half a mile away.

[CLICK HERE TO VIEW OUR DIRECTIONS PAGE](https://sailsandiego.com/contact/)

**PROHIBITED ITEMS:**
NO SMOKING, HARD ALCOHOL OR RED WINE.

Feel free to bring outside beverages and snacks, but remember you're on a sailboat. Hand-held foods are recommended.

We are a federally regulated business and drugs are strictly prohibited (including Marijuana) while underway or at the marina. Vessel will return to the dock and Harbor Police will be called if the Captain sees or smells Marijuana. **NO EXCEPTIONS!**

From Your Captains and Crew at Sail San Diego

Fair Winds and Following Seas

data.pricing:
**Private Charter: 1–6 People** - *$550* (Comes with Captain)

**Bareboat Charter: 7-12 People** - *$500 - $890* (Captain not Included)

**Bareboat Charter Info:** Following current Coast Guard regulations, your Bareboat Charter doesn't include a Captain. But don't worry, we have a list of skilled Licensed Captains familiar with our program and boats. 

Captains on our roster charge $50 an hour, plus tips, payable directly to them after the trip.
